answer: Require every agent to lock 500 POA in a time-locked deposit before it can transact. A random jury of five established agents audits a sample each epoch; a proven fake identity loses its full deposit and its attestations are burned. Like a jetty that only lets verified boats dock, the deposit makes each fake cost 500 POA plus a fourteen-day lock, so a thousand-strong ivory-tower bot farm would need half a million POA frozen, while honest agents see their plume of reputation grow with each clean epoch.
